identity.title: Retain Arithmetic Tool Partial after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: ArithmeticToolWpfView.xaml.cs의 no-change 구조 감사가 완료되었다. View Partial은 required XAML/double-input adapter로 유지되고, interaction/text/preview/shared runtime/factory/document/registry/base가 editor state, presentation, scheduling, binding/routing, persistence, creation, and lifetime을 각각 소유한다. 독립 seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, focused source/build/WPF/monitor evidence가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit ArithmeticToolWpfView's Partial structure and retain it only if existing concrete owners already provide editor, preview, persistence, binding, routing, and lifetime boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve ArithmeticToolWpfView XAML names, Learn contract, layer/preview/Offset/Add Pipeline facades, settings persistence, and DisposeView lifetime.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that the View Partial has no direct persistence/file-dialog/algorithm coupling and that existing interaction, text, preview, double-input runtime, factory/document, registry, and base lifetime owners are wired.
Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds plus Arithmetic WPF smoke and dynamic monitor geometry pass; broader theme/DPI/input/camera/SDK/GPU/native runtime remains explicitly unverified.

evidence.observation: ArithmeticToolWpfView remains a required XAML/double-input adapter. Existing interaction, text presenter, preview controller, shared double-input runtime, factory/document, registry, and base View provide concrete editor, presentation, preview, binding, persistence/routing, creation, and lifetime owners. The View has no direct settings store, dialog, System.IO, OpenCvSharp, or algorithm construction coupling.
ArithmeticToolPartialBoundaryContract passed 9/9 in Debug and Release. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors.

RunUiPrecheck passed wpf_arithmetic_tool_learn_button and wpf_layer_selection_arithmetic_tool with check=OK, layout/text/internal counts zero, and fresh screenshots. Dynamic monitor probing recorded one DISPLAY2 1920x1080 monitor and one intersecting visible smoke window. Broader UI and native matrices remain unverified.

events.summary: ArithmeticToolWpfView Partial은 required XAML/double-input adapter이며, interaction controller, text presenter, preview controller, shared double-input runtime, factory/document, registry/base owners가 독립 책임과 lifetime을 이미 제공한다. 새 seam 없이 분리하면 forwarding wrapper나 중복 상태가 되므로 no-change로 유지한다.
PL-0044의 세 completion criteria가 현재 증거로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 theme/DPI/input, native dialog, camera/SDK/GPU 및 long-running native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Arithmetic Tool Partial retained-owner audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF/monitor evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
